description: This PHP source file defines the CopyProjectActivityAPI class, which provides API endpoints for copying project activities between projects within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for listing copyable activities, executing the copy operation, and relevant validation rules. The class interacts with project activity data and respects project existence validation.
